arguments.question: Across ANET, QQQ, MU, META and NVDA, assess 21/63-session macro and policy transmission channels using the fixed SPY/IWM/HYG context and available Fed/rates materials: identify facts on rates/monetary policy and distinguish scenarios for long-duration technology valuations, AI capital spending, advertising and semiconductor demand. Do not make return forecasts. Stop after the latest relevant Fed material and available normalized market/rates observations; state gaps.
arguments.decision_impact: Could determine whether a common macro regime supports or contradicts company-specific and QQQ look-through theses, and flag market-wide review conditions.
